## Purpose

This document records the computational environment used for the dissertation analysis. It provides a reproducibility record of the R environment without importing, modifying, or analysing ANES data.
## Project Reproducibility Settings

```{r project-reproducibility-settings}
current_dir <- normalizePath(
  getwd(),
  winslash = "/"
)

if (basename(current_dir) == "notebooks") {
  project_root <- dirname(current_dir)
} else {
  project_root <- current_dir
}

project_file <- file.path(
  project_root,
  "ANES.Rproj"
)

project_options <- readLines(
  project_file
)

workspace_options <- project_options[
  grepl(
    "^(RestoreWorkspace|SaveWorkspace):",
    project_options
  )
]

workspace_options

stopifnot(
  "RestoreWorkspace: No" %in%
    workspace_options,
  "SaveWorkspace: No" %in%
    workspace_options
)

"PASS: automatic workspace restore and save are disabled"
```
## renv Environment

```{r renv-environment}
renv_lockfile <- file.path(
  project_root,
  "renv.lock"
)

stopifnot(
  file.exists(renv_lockfile)
)

renv_status <- renv::status(
  project = project_root
)

renv_lockfile_sha256 <- digest::digest(
  file = renv_lockfile,
  algo = "sha256",
  serialize = FALSE
)

renv_environment_audit <- data.frame(
  Renv_version = as.character(
    packageVersion("renv")
  ),
  Lockfile_exists = file.exists(
    renv_lockfile
  ),
  Library_and_lockfile_synchronized =
    isTRUE(renv_status$synchronized),
  Lockfile_SHA256 = renv_lockfile_sha256
)

renv_environment_audit

stopifnot(
  renv_environment_audit$Lockfile_exists,
  renv_environment_audit$
    Library_and_lockfile_synchronized,
  grepl(
    "^[0-9a-f]{64}$",
    renv_environment_audit$Lockfile_SHA256
  )
)

"PASS: renv environment gate"
```
